source.organization: Liberia Institute of Statistics and Geo-Information Services
source.dataset: LISGIS 2022 Population and Housing Census administrative GIS shapefiles
source.geometry_processing: GDAL reprojection from EPSG:32629 to EPSG:4326; Mapshaper polygon normalization only

description: Represents the 160 district polygon boundaries and their parent counties in the LISGIS 2022 Population and Housing Census administrative cartography. Source shapefiles use WGS 1984 / UTM zone 29N (EPSG:32629); published coordinates are reprojected to WGS 84 geographic coordinates (EPSG:4326). No observation period is assigned: this boundary geometry has a 2022 source vintage but no statistical observation period.
